modules.module_title: Perform automated metal cutting plasma by inspecting equipment, preparing materials, and configuring cutting programs for efficient operation.

pcs.pc_description: Inspect the plasma cutting machine, ensuring all components are in good condition and properly functioning. This includes the cutting torch, power supply, CNC controller, gas supply, and any safety features.
Prepare the metal sheets or work pieces to be cut. This involves ensuring they are clean, free from any contaminants, and properly positioned on the cutting table or fixture.

Load the cutting program into the CNC controller or computer interface. Verify that the program includes the correct cutting parameters such as cutting speed, amperage, gas flow rates, and pierce delay.

modules.module_title: Set up Gas supply to the plasma cutting machine & do the alignment

pcs.pc_description: Select the appropriate gas for the cutting process based on the material being cut. Common gases used include oxygen, nitrogen, and argon, each offering different advantages depending on the application
Set the gas pressure and flow rates according to the manufacturer's recommendations and the requirements of the cutting program. Proper gas control is crucial for achieving clean and accurate cuts.

Ensure the cutting torch is properly positioned and aligned with the starting point of the cut on the work piece. Proper alignment helps to prevent errors in the cutting path and ensures consistent quality.

modules.module_title: Prepare and set up automated metal cutting plasma systems with a focus on safety measures, test cuts, and quality control for optimal operation

pcs.pc_description: Implement safety measures to protect personnel and equipment during operation. This includes wearing appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE), installing safety guards, and ensuring emergency stop buttons are easily accessible.
Conduct test cuts on scrap material to verify the cutting parameters and make any necessary adjustments before proceeding with the actual cutting job.

• Monitor the cutting process closely to ensure the desired cut quality is achieved. This involves checking for smooth edges, minimal dross (residue), and accurate dimensions according to the specification. •
